q: Are the prices on SAT always current?
a: No. Product prices can change frequently. Any price range shown on SAT should be treated as a guide. Always check the retailer for the latest price and availability.

q: Will an affiliate link increase the price I pay?
a: Normally, no. If SAT later earns a commission from a qualifying purchase, the customer typically pays the retailer’s normal purchase price. Any affiliate relationship will be clearly disclosed.

q: Will affiliate commissions affect SAT recommendations?
